highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Culinary Arts Academy is one of the world's finest culinary schools and is one the Switzerland's best. It’s ranked seventh in the world in the hospitality and leisure category by QS World University Rankings. The academy is a sister school of César Ritz Colleges, Switzerland.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
As a student, you'll have a vibrant and multicultural environment at Culinary Arts Academy. The academy has students from over 60 nationalities, with more than 250 students enrolled per term.

With well-equipped kitchens, recreational areas, and modern culinary facilities, you’ll enhance your learning experience as a student at the academy. You’ll enjoy a wide range of cultural events, banquets, well-being workshops, and clubs to join at the academy, and this includes the Green Globe Club, Wine Club, and Music Club.

You also have the opportunity to interact with a student counsellor on each campus to assist you when you are sick, or if you need medical appointments.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Culinary Arts Academy, you’ll get warm and cozy accommodations on campus. The academy provides double standard rooms, single deluxe rooms, and single superior deluxe rooms as part of the accommodation. You also get access to a fully-equipped fitness centre and other facilities.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Sports
In summer, you can enjoy various water sports, and in winter, you can explore many famous ski resorts that are less than 30 minutes away from the campus.

Laboratory
As a hotel management school, Culinary Arts Academy doesn’t have a laboratory. Instead, it houses the Apicius Culinary Training Centre, the Mane Food Development Lab, multiple application kitchens, fine dining, and buffet spaces.

Situated at the Le Bouveret campus, the Apicius Culinary Training Centre is a five-story building with state-of-the-art professional kitchens and spaces for exclusive events. You’ll learn how to cook in front of guests, present the menu, serve, and handle guest requests.
